title: Honey Milk Active Repair Leave In Conditioner Mist

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Leave-In Conditioner > Hair Styling & Treatments > Hair

descriptionHtml:
✓ Heat Protection✓ Increases Shine✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Good for: Damage✓ Good for: Frizz✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A leave-in conditioner mist powered by Mirsalehi Honey, hydrolyzed milk protein, and ceramides to repair, detangle, smooth, and protect hair.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Heat Protection
- Shine
- Frizz

Key Benefits:
- Instant detangling
- Frizz control
- Heat protection up to 450°F/230°C

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Intensely nourishes, hydrates, and boosts shine.
- Hydrolyzed Milk Protein: Strengthens and reduces breakage.
- Ceramides: Restore and repair.

What Else You Need to Know: Light as milk yet rich as honey
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well and mist evenly onto damp hair in long, fluid strokes from mid-lengths to ends.
-Comb and detangle, starting at the ends and working up.
-Style as usual.
-To add shape, follow with the Honey Milk 5-in-1 Styling Cream (sold separately) and style as desired.
-To add shine, apply a few drops of Honey Infused Hair Oil (sold separately) to dry, styled hair for an extra boost of shine.

As an Overnight Treatment:
-Shake the leave-in conditioner well and mist evenly onto dry hair in long, fluid strokes, focusing on the ends.
-Apply a few drops of Honey Infused Hair Oil (sold separately) to lock in the Leave-In Conditioner and intensify the overnight treatment.
-Pro Tip: After applying, put your hair into a protective style like a loose braid and use a silk pillowcase or silk bonnet.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Intensely nourishes, hydrates, and boosts shine.
-Hydrolyzed Milk Protein: Strengthens and reduces breakage.
-Ceramides: Restore and repair.

Aqua (Water, Eau), Propanediol, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Hydrolyzed Milk Protein, Ceramide NP , Ceramide AP, Laurdimonium Hydroxypropyl Hydrolyzed Barley Protein, Panthenol, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Fucus Vesiculosus Extract, Juliana Adstringens Bark Extract, Origanum Vulgare Leaf Extract, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Glycerin, Glycosphingolipids, Tetraacetylphytosphingosine, Behenyl/Stearyl Aminopropanediol Esters, Isopropyl Myristate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Sodium Gluconate, Parfum (Fragrance), Cholesterol, Stearic Acid,

Product Disclosures: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water. Discontinue if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
